_provenance: EXTERNAL RESEARCH - NOT from this repo's committed API snapshots. Every other number in this demo is re-derived from data/raw/ by demo/evaluate.py. These are not, and the UI says so on screen. Sourced from DCAS Notices of Examination and union publications, compiled 2026-08-07. Treat salaries as base minimums from NOEs: they exclude overtime, differentials, and pending collective-bargaining increases.
_caveat: Promotional exams do NOT run on a fixed annual cycle. Each entry below is the MOST RECENT KNOWN CYCLE, not an open filing window. Confirm against the live DCAS schedule (Socrata 4ptz-hmtc) before acting on any of it. Filing windows run about three weeks and DCAS offers no automatic notification when a worker becomes eligible - that gap is the point.

TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT AGENT.gates: Permanent (not provisional) competitive appointment as TEA, at least one year served in title. Score is 85% multiple-choice + 15% seniority. NYS driver license required by promotion.
TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT AGENT.salary_note: Base minimum $50,276 (Associate TEA) against $38,333 at TEA Level I.
TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT AGENT.also: Promotion to Police Officer, Exam 6539, admits TEAs on a collateral basis under Civil Service Law section 52(1). Honest caveat: that is the same instrument offered to the public - incumbency lets you sit a restricted list, it adds no points to your score.

SCHOOL SAFETY AGENT.gates: Permanent (not provisional) competitive appointment as School Safety Agent. Application fee was $85.00.
SCHOOL SAFETY AGENT.salary_note: Base minimum $74,344 (Supervisor of School Security) against $39,206 starting as an SSA.
SCHOOL SAFETY AGENT.also: Promotion to Police Officer, Exam 6539, also admits SSAs on a collateral section 52(1) basis. Honest caveat: there is no SSA-specific score, age, or education preference - this is a real pipeline, not a formal bridge.

EMERGENCY MEDICAL SPECIALIST-EMT.pathway_type: Formal promotional ladder (restricted to FDNY incumbents)
EMERGENCY MEDICAL SPECIALIST-EMT.gates: Permanent (not provisional) competitive appointment as Emergency Medical Specialist-EMT. Requires EMT-Paramedic plus REMAC certification; FDNY sponsors the Medic Upgrade Program, which carries a three-year service commitment.
EMERGENCY MEDICAL SPECIALIST-EMT.salary_note: Base minimum $53,891 (Paramedic) against $39,386 starting as an EMT.
EMERGENCY MEDICAL SPECIALIST-EMT.also: Promotion to Firefighter, Exam 4528, is the larger jump but is gated on four years served in title, not one.

CARETAKER.gates: Permanent competitive appointment as Caretaker; NYCHA promotions require one year in current title and location. Score is 85% test + 15% seniority. Application fee was $68.00, and fee waivers widened substantially under Local Law 57 of 2025 effective July 1, 2026.
CARETAKER.salary_note: Base minimums from the NOE; the FY2025 payroll median for CARETAKER on this page is $52,086.
CARETAKER.also: Teamsters Local 237 runs free exam-prep for this ladder through its Education Department - in practice the most reliable early warning a caretaker gets.
